title: First Repeated Value
statement:
Read a list of integers from left to right. Find the first position whose value has already appeared at an earlier position, and report that value. If no value appears twice, report that instead.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the repeated value, or the word `NONE` if all values are different.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
